title: Source Resolution
description: Resolves whether the active instruction source is REPO, PACKAGE, or MIXED.
intent: Determine the authoritative source of active instructions (repository, package, or mixed) to govern task execution boundaries.
outcome: Typed source-resolution record with mode, authority, provenance evidence, and reason codes.
constraints: Source mode must be deterministically resolved as REPO, PACKAGE, or MIXED.
Fail closed when source authority cannot be distinguished.
Provenance evidence must be verified, not guessed.
Must stay inside intake_context family with G0_CONTEXT gate only.

reason_codes.ACCEPTED: Source mode resolved deterministically with verified provenance.
reason_codes.AMBIGUOUS: Repository and package authority cannot be distinguished.
reason_codes.MALFORMED: Provenance evidence is incomplete or invalid.
reason_codes.MISSING_EVIDENCE: Required source inputs cannot be audited.
reason_codes.INVALID_MODE: Resolved source mode token is not REPO, PACKAGE, or MIXED.
